about_the_game:
The "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle" Character Pass bundle includes all 7 playable characters.

※The additional content included in the Character Pass will be released incrementally, with multiple releases scheduled through September 2026.

What's included:

Tanjiro Kamado (Infinity Castle) Character Pack

Zenitsu Agatsuma (Infinity Castle) Character Pack

Giyu Tomioka (Infinity Castle) Character Pack

Shinobu Kocho (Infinity Castle) Character Pack

Doma Character Pack

Akaza (Infinity Castle) Character Pack

Kaigaku Character Pack

※To use this content, purchase of the full game "Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2" is required. Additionally, the latest patch must be applied.

※Individual sales of the character packs included in the “Character Pass” are also available. Please review the product details carefully to avoid duplicate purchases.

※The additional characters can only be used battles in "Versus Mode."

※Content details and release schedules are subject to change. For the latest information, please visit the official website ).

※To use the additional characters, downloading each character pack is required.

※Content and specifications are subject to change without notice.

※Game illustrations are created by CyberConnect2 Co., Ltd. based on the 3D models in-game.

content_descriptors.notes: There are blood effects and decapitation as you fight demons.
